title: Common-profile-floor reduction for label-dependent Gaussian covariances

common_floor_reduction.hypothesis: For every label z, S_(N,z)=S_(N,*)+C_(N,z) with C_(N,z)>=0, where the one common floor S_(N,*) is stationary diagonal and lies in a fixed relative K1572 profile band.
common_floor_reduction.representation: With W_N standard Gaussian and G_(N,*)~N(0,S_(N,*)) independent, M_N=m_(N,Z)+C_(N,Z)^(1/2)W_N and X_N=M_N+G_(N,*) satisfy Law(X_N|Z=z)=N(m_(N,z),S_(N,z)).
common_floor_reduction.channel: The heterogeneous Gaussian mixture is exactly a continuous location mixture over the one common channel covariance S_(N,*), even when the C_(N,z) have arbitrary eigenvectors.
common_floor_reduction.scope_guard: A common stationary diagonal profiled Loewner floor is load-bearing. The reduction does not cover covariance families with no such floor, non-Gaussian component shapes, phases, textures, nonstationarity, or unrestricted states.
